summary: Unknown Worlds' underwater survival-adventure series, centered on ocean exploration, crafting, base-building, and environmental storytelling.

entries.title: Subnautica

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulator route is needed.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity, most configurable route for the complete original game, with PC settings/mod support and the cleanest capture path. Later console, mobile, and Switch 2 versions are useful access routes but do not add exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows build through Steam/Epic/Microsoft Store with high settings; use PC mods only if they are wanted for capture or quality-of-life, not as required story content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Switch 2/mobile ports improve access on those devices but do not supersede PC as the archive route.
